name: Delivery
cliff: Kal Bunty ka date… aur shirt?
caption: Ep 5/10 — Promise chesina rojuke delivery ✅ Kaani Bunty plan enti? 🤨 #DostUndiGa #IronDost #Hyderabad

clips.title: Before / after
beats: Frame 1 in motion: extreme close-up of RAVI's fist crushing a badly crumpled navy-blue shirt with thin white checks, in harsh dull light by the clothes pile.
A fast whip-pan to the right across the room, motion-blurred, landing on the sunny window.

In slow motion the lucky shirt, now perfectly ironed with a sharp collar, snaps open on a hanger held up by RAVI in front of the sunny window. A soft puff of steam drifts off it and sunlight flares behind. RAVI, in a grey vest, closes his eyes in bliss.
RAVI brings the shirt close to his face and touches the freshly stitched second button with his fingertip, tapping it twice. His eyebrows shoot up in delight.
RAVI hugs the hanger to his chest, sways a little, and grins at the shirt like a proud father.
clips.camera: Starts in an extreme close-up on the fist, whip-pans right to the window, then eases into a medium close-up of RAVI with the crisp shirt and pushes in slightly on the button. One continuous move.
clips.sound: Fabric crunch at 0.0 s, whip-pan whoosh at 1.5 s, crisp fabric snap at 2.5 s, a soft choir 'aah' and steam hiss at 3 s, two button taps at 5.5 s. No music.
clips.first: RAVI's fist already squeezing the crumpled navy checked shirt in dull light.
clips.last: RAVI hugging the crisp navy checked shirt on its hanger in front of the sunny window, grinning.
clips.edit_text: 0.2 s: '2 rojula mundu…' (big, top third). 2.6 s: '…ippudu'. 5.8 s: 'Loose button? Stitched ✓'
neg_extra: a visible cut instead of a whip-pan
the shirt changing pattern or colour between before and after

clips.title: Delivery and the showroom shirts
beats: At the flat's front door, RAVI in a pressed formal shirt opens the door. DOST stands outside with a neat stack of plain royal-blue garment bags on hanger hooks and folded white bedsheets, calm smile.
DOST hands the bags over and speaks. RAVI takes them carefully in both arms, nodding.
DOST gives a small nod and steps back out of frame. RAVI turns, carries the bags to the sofa beside the door and lays one flat.
RAVI pulls the zip open: a row of crisp ironed shirts on hangers with sharp collars. His face lights up and he lifts one sleeve as he speaks, amazed.
clips.camera: Static medium shot at the door that slowly pans with RAVI to the sofa and pushes in on the opening zip and his lit-up face. One continuous move.

lines.en: Ironing order, in two days, as promised.

lines.native: ఇవి నా షర్ట్స్ ఆ? షోరూమ్ లాగా ఉన్నాయి!
lines.roman: Ivi naa shirts aa? Showroom laga unnayi!
lines.en: These are my shirts? They look like a showroom!

clips.sound: Doorbell at 0.0 s, door latch click, garment bags rustling at 2.5 s, zip rip at 6 s. No music.
clips.first: RAVI opening the door to DOST holding the royal-blue garment bags and white bedsheets.
clips.last: Close on RAVI's amazed face over the open bag of crisp shirts.
clips.edit_text: 2 s: small tag 'Ironing · 2 days'. Kinetic captions for both lines
neg_extra: any logo, print or text on the bags or DOST's polo

clips.title: Paid, and Bunty feels the fabric
beats: In the foreground RAVI stands with his phone, tapping it with his thumb; the phone faces away from the camera and a royal-blue glow lights his face. He nods, satisfied.
RAVI walks out of frame to the left, still looking at the phone. Behind him, the navy checked lucky shirt hangs on the open almirah door.
BUNTY, in a crumpled maroon printed shirt, sidles up to the almirah, glances over his shoulder, and secretly rubs the shirt's sleeve between his thumb and fingers.
BUNTY's eyebrows rise, impressed, and he mutters; then he glances around guiltily and drops the sleeve as if it were hot.
clips.camera: Starts on RAVI's blue-lit face in the foreground, racks focus past him to the almirah and slowly pushes in on BUNTY at the shirt. One continuous move.
clips.sound: Two soft phone taps at 0.5 s, a payment 'ping' at 2 s, soft fabric rub at 5 s, BUNTY's guilty throat-clear at 9 s. No music.
clips.first: RAVI tapping his phone, royal-blue glow on his face, the shirt on the almirah door blurred behind.
clips.last: BUNTY dropping the sleeve and glancing around guiltily.
clips.edit_text: 1.5 s: edit graphic beside the phone: order bill → 'Paid ✓' → 'Delivered ✓'
neg_extra: a readable phone screen, bill or payment UI

clips.title: Baigan…
beats: BUNTY's trouser pocket buzzes. He pulls out his phone, which faces away from the camera; a royal-blue glow lights his face and his eyes go wide with surprise, then a delighted grin.
BUNTY turns to a plastic chair heaped with his own crumpled shirts, lifts one up by the collar; it hangs limp and wrinkled. His face falls and he whispers.
BUNTY drops the shirt back on the heap. His eyes slowly slide to the right, toward the open almirah where the crisp navy checked shirt hangs alone in a beam of sunlight.
Over BUNTY's shoulder the view pushes slowly toward the shirt in the beam of light, BUNTY's profile soft in the foreground, his eyes narrowing.
clips.camera: Starts on BUNTY's blue-lit face, follows him to the chair, then a slow over-the-shoulder push toward the crisp shirt in the sunbeam. One continuous move.
clips.sound: Phone buzz and notification ding at 0.0 s, limp fabric flop at 3 s, a sneaky pizzicato from 6 s (sound effect plucks only). No music.
clips.first: BUNTY pulling his buzzing phone from his pocket, blue glow starting on his face.
clips.last: Over BUNTY's shoulder: the crisp navy checked shirt alone in a beam of light inside the almirah.
clips.edit_text: 0.5 s: notification card slides down beside the phone: 'Ayesha 💕: Kal 7 baje, Paradise?'. Cliffhanger at 8 s: 'Kal Bunty ka date… aur shirt?' then the end card
neg_extra: a readable phone screen or chat
